heroHeadline: Day 717: Record 59-Million-Liter Fuel Seizure in Guanajuato as Sheinbaum Confirms Trump Call 'Advancing Well' on Trade Deal
heroSubtitle: September 18, 2026 marks Day 717 of Claudia Sheinbaum's presidency. Holding her mañanera in Irapuato, Guanajuato alongside Governor Libia Dennise García, Sheinbaum's Security Cabinet disclosed a seizure of more than 59 million liters of unverified-origin fuel in San José Iturbide — the largest single fuel seizure of her administration — and reported a 75% drop in the state's daily homicide average since October 2024. She also confirmed a September 16 phone call with President Trump, her 22nd since taking office, saying talks were "advancing well" on a possible trade agreement ahead of Round 4 USMCA negotiations September 28–29 in Washington, and lamented the femicide of Spanish exchange student Claudia Tacoronte in Cuautla, Morelos, whose suspected killer was arrested. The previous day, September 17, she previewed the September 19 national earthquake drill and announced a Route 57 highway extension to the US border. On September 16, she had led the civic-military parade marking the 216th anniversary of Mexican independence, reviewing 15,458 troops as 99 aircraft flew over the Zócalo for the first time; the night before, she delivered her second Grito de Independencia before a record Zócalo crowd of more than 300,000.
